title: Stabilize mobile header Sheet overlay/background rendering and prevent blank/transparent screen recurrence

requirements.summary: Ensure the mobile header Sheet always opens with a full-viewport dimmed overlay and an opaque right-side panel across light/dark themes (no transparent/blank screen).
acceptanceCriteria: On a mobile viewport, tapping the header menu button opens a right-side panel and a dimmed overlay; the screen never becomes fully transparent/blank.
The sheet panel background is opaque (not transparent) and uses the app theme colors (light/dark).
The overlay covers the full viewport and has a visible dim (e.g., semi-transparent dark layer) behind the panel.
Closing the menu (swipe/close button/tap outside) returns to the exact prior screen without visual corruption.

file_operations.description: Harden the mobile menu Sheet rendering by explicitly applying opaque theme background + foreground colors and robust z-index to the shadcn-ui SheetContent (Radix Sheet) via className props, and ensure the trigger/header remains visually consistent. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add app-level defensive styling for mobile-only (and safe desktop) to guarantee an always-visible dim overlay and opaque sheet content for the Radix Sheet/Dialog portal content (overlay/content selectors), ensuring the underlying page remains visible behind the overlay. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a global CSS override in index.css to enforce non-transparent Radix/Sheet overlay and correct overlay/content stacking (z-index) without editing any ui component files.
acceptanceCriteria: The CSS fix is implemented only via app-level styles (e.g., index.css) and/or className props in app-owned components (e.g., Header.tsx), and does not require editing any files under frontend/src/components/ui.
The overlay/content stacking works correctly: header/menu button is not visually lost behind a transparent layer; the overlay sits above the app content and the sheet content sits above the overlay.
The fix works consistently across at least these views: landing, about, dashboard, admin (when available).

file_operations.description: Implement a targeted, defensive override for Radix Sheet/Dialog portal elements (overlay + content) to enforce: (1) overlay has a consistent dim background (non-transparent), (2) content has an opaque background matching theme variables, and (3) overlay/content z-index ordering is correct on mobile. Must not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align Header’s mobile Sheet className(s) with the global CSS override by adding stable, app-owned class hooks (e.g., a unique class on SheetContent) and ensuring the sheet panel always uses an opaque background in both themes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Prevent the mobile menu from leaving intermediate visual states by closing it deterministically on navigation and during view-activation overlay transitions.
acceptanceCriteria: While the mobile menu is open, navigating using any menu item always closes the menu and lands on the selected view without a blank/transparent screen.
If the ViewActivationOverlay is shown (e.g., navigating to dashboard/admin), the UI remains readable and does not become transparent/blank when the mobile menu was previously opened.
Repeated open/close cycles of the mobile menu do not degrade the page rendering (no intermittent blank state).

file_operations.description: Make mobile Sheet open/close state resilient: close the menu before triggering navigation (optionally defer navigation by a microtask/animation frame to allow Radix close animation/portal cleanup), and add a defensive effect to force-close the menu when dashboard/admin view activation begins (via ViewActivationContext flags already used in Header). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm the overlay remains visually readable alongside (or after) Sheet usage by ensuring its stacking context remains above app content and that its background is never transparent/blank under mobile conditions (z-index alignment with the Sheet fixes).
